artifacts.summary: Five-phase, 2-hour plan: tracked-ness check in check_probe (git ls-files --error-unmatch) with header/footer rule; delete the two untracked 706/710 WIRED_REPO entries (option a, library subsumes them); re-point FMP/README.md and Limits/README.md to the landed FiniteCarrier.*/NoFiniteWidth.* names; one-sentence archival-mv note in the source store; full gate with check-evidence-probes.sh at 26 probes and guarded lake build.

memory_candidates.content: A file-presence test ([ -f ]) in a repo gate is satisfied by a gitignored file, so a gate that cites files by path stays green locally and fails on every clean checkout/CI. In this task system, archival (/todo or /task --abandon) moves a task directory into specs/archive/ with plain mv, and specs/archive/ is gitignored, so any guard entry pointing into a live task directory is silently un-tracked the day that task is archived. The durable predicate is `git ls-files --error-unmatch -- FILE` (TRACKED, not merely present); the durable fix is to promote the file into a tracked, task-independent collection (specs/evidence/) before archival, or delete the entry once a lake-build-guarded library theorem subsumes it.
